sqlquery.from: (select (ii.id*ii.invoice_id) as id, 'Sales' as type, (CASE WHEN inv.iscreditnote=true THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END) creditnote, inv.number as number, COALESCE(ii.itemname, it.name) itemname, ii.unitprice unitprice, tr.journalDate as transactiondate, ii.qty quantity,a.name as accountname , ii.description as description , cast(coalesce(icf.string_value1, '1') as float) as points from "$".transaction tr left join "$".invoice inv on (tr.invoiceid = inv.id and inv.type='RECEIVABLE') left join "$".invoiceitem ii on inv.id = ii.invoice_id left join "$".item it on ii.item_id = it.id left join "$".itemcustomfields icf on it.customfieldsid=icf.id left join "$".account a on ii.account_id = a.id join "$".reference r on (inv.status_id = r.id and r.code in ('APPROVE', 'OPEN', 'PAID', 'OVER_DUE') ) left join "public".accounttype acc on (a.accounttypeid = acc.id and acc.code = 'REVENUE') where tr.invoiceid is not null and tr.deleted is not true union all select (ex.id*100) as id, 'Expense' as type, 'no' as creditnote, ex.number as number, 'expense' as itemname, (eitem.costperunit+(eitem.taxamount/eitem.units)) as unitprice, tr.journalDate as transactiondate , eitem.units as quantity, a.name as accountname ,ex.description as description, 0 as points from "$".transaction tr left join "$".expenseReport ex on tr.expenseReportid = ex.id left join "$".expense eitem on ex.id = eitem.reportId left join "$".account a on eitem.accountId = a.id where tr.expenseReportid is not null and tr.deleted is not true) as t
